ValidationRule.description: On the Account Management record type, require the Outcome when closing the case.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed"), ISBLANK( TEXT(Outcome__c)), RecordTypeId= "0121a000000EoXk" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Outcome cannot be blank when closing an Account Management case.
